items.hook: The Great Victorian Collection, published in 1975, is a fantasy novel by Northern Irish-Canadian writer Brian Moore.It tells the story of a man who dreams that the empty parking lot he can see from his hotel window has been transformed by the arrival of a collection of priceless Victoriana on display in a vast open-air market.
items.body: When he awakes he finds that he can no longer distinguish the dream from reality. One of those things you can't un-know.
